args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. Remediation: rolled back all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was never in production) and rolled back all regions to it.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation via that incident.
